question: Under what conditions can the Autel EVO Max 4N fail to return home after losing signal?
stop_reason: claims still failing after the revision limit

intake.focus: Autel EVO Max 4N lost link return home conditions
intake.reason: Query seeks guidance from manuals/reports on loss of control link and RTH behavior for the Autel EVO Max 4N

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance indicates reestablishing the control link when lost and, if unsuccessful, initiating emergency procedures; it also requires the remote PIC to take immediate direct control and to include control-link loss procedures in preflight briefings. Autel EVO Max 4N manuals state that automatic RTH after signal loss will keep trying to reconnect, and if reconnection isn’t established within 10 seconds, a warning is shown and Signal Loss Action is executed; during manual flight, loss of connection causes a slow hover followed by Signal Lost. Unverified incident reports claim loss of control shortly after takeoff, failed Return To Home attempts, and the platform not being located or recovered.

claims.text: If the control link is lost, try to reestablish the control link with the small unmanned aircraft; if the connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.
claims.quote: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft.

claims.text: Prior to flight, ensure the remote PIC briefing includes control link loss procedures.
claims.quote: The preflight briefing must include control link loss procedures.

claims.text: AC 107-2A states to discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft.
claims.quote: Discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft.
conditions: until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft.

claims.text: The remote PIC must be able to take immediate, direct control to address hazardous situations during operations.
claims.quote: This ability is necessary to ensure the remote PIC can quickly address any hazardous situation.

claims.text: The manual states that during the execution of automatic RTH caused by signal loss, the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect.
claims.quote: During the execution of automatic RTH caused by signal loss, the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect.
conditions: automatic RTH active due to signal loss

claims.text: The manual states that "If reconnection is not established within 10 seconds, the Autel Enterprise App will display the warning message “Aircraft disconnected.”, and the drone will execute the preset Signal Loss Action."
claims.quote: If reconnection is not established within 10 seconds, the Autel Enterprise App will display the warning message “Aircraft disconnected.”, and the drone will execute the preset Signal Loss Action.

claims.text: The manual states that "During manual flight, upon losing connection, the drone will slow down and hover," and will then execute the Signal Lost behavior after the disconnection message is shown in the app.
claims.quote: During manual flight, upon losing connection, the drone will slow down and hover.

claims.text: The reporter states: 'I completely lost control of the UAS,' shortly after takeoff, and the platform continued to fly away from me.
claims.quote: I completely lost control of the UAS.

claims.text: The reporter states: 'All attempts of Return To Home features failed'.
claims.quote: All attempts of Return To Home features failed

claims.text: The reporter states: 'UAS Platform has not been located or recovered'.
claims.quote: UAS Platform has not been located or recovered

gaps.text: Autel manual: drone will continue to reconnect during automatic RTH, conflicting with FAA guidance to reestablish the link and take immediate control.
Autel manual: 10-second reconnection leads to 'Aircraft disconnected' and Signal Loss Action, conflicting with FAA guidance to discontinue flight until link is tested.
Autel manual: during manual flight, losing connection causes slow hover and then Signal Lost action; FAA requires the remote PIC to take immediate direct control.
Evidence about the conditions under which return-home fails after signal loss is not verified in the sources.
No verified incident detail clarifies whether Return To Home features can fail across different flight modes.
Unverified reports claim loss of control and unrecovered platform; reliability of these claims is unclear.
